style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

caption: DNA has 64 possible three-letter codons; the I-Ching has 64 six-line patterns, called hexagrams. The count alone does not show a shared origin. sixlines.day

pages.a:
DNA HAS 64 POSSIBLE CODONS.
EACH IS THREE LETTERS LONG.
THE LETTERS ARE A, C, G, T.

A BOOK WITH 64 HEXAGRAMS.
EACH IS A SIX-LINE PATTERN:
YIN IS BROKEN; YANG IS SOLID.

CODONS: 4 X 4 X 4 = 64.
HEXAGRAMS:
2 X 2 X 2 X 2 X 2 X 2 = 64.

pages.q: DOES THIS SHOW A SHARED ORIGIN
pages.a:
NO. THE COUNT ALONE
DOES NOT SHOW A SHARED ORIGIN.

SAME NUMBER.
NOT THE SAME CODE.
